scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @zig/api" "npm run dev -w @zig/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zig/shared && npm run build -w @zig/api && npm run build -w @zig/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @zig/shared && npm run test -w @zig/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @zig/api && npm run lint -w @zig/web
